peer_results.rationale: The retrieved AMD disclosures focus on specific segment performance metrics (Client operating income) and Goodwill definitions/reporting units, rather than the general operating segment reporting scope, intersegment activity inclusion, or reconciliation references to Note 3 that characterize the target Intel disclosure.

The retrieved AVGO disclosures focus on drivers of net revenue and operating income for specific segments (Infrastructure Software, Semiconductor Solutions) rather than the structural definition of operating segment reporting, intersegment financial activity, or the reconciliation reference found in the Intel disclosure.

The retrieved Micron disclosures are generic references to 'Recently Issued Accounting Standards' or 'Other Operating Expenses' in Item 8 notes. They do not address the specific topic of operating segment reporting scope, intersegment financial activity, or the reconciliation between segment and consolidated results central to the Intel disclosure.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA operates in two segments: Compute & Networking and Graphics, with further details available in Note 17.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA explicitly define their operating segments and reference the specific Note in the financial statements for detailed reconciliation and further information. Intel states that operating segment results include intersegment activity and directs readers to Note 3 for reconciliation with consolidated results. Similarly, NVIDIA identifies its two operating segments (Compute & Networking and Graphics) and refers readers to Note 17 for additional information on these segments.
